name: system_get_state

provenance.source: exact 3.101.036 IDB vela_ap.bin.i64; body shape identical to the reviewed 3.101.043 function and unique in this image; __func__ string cross-references agree for the MiWearScreen and PowerManager entries

notes: system_all_state getter (get_connect_state/get_switch_state/...): zeroes out[0..1] then stores the state byte. id 1 is the MiWear connection (0 not reported, 1 down, 2 up). Spins forever (Band 10 Pro) or panics (Band 11) when system_init_state has not run, so the state pointer must be checked first.
